card.name: Inside drug-interaction phrases and PK terms
card.fires_on: A word in the middle of a noun phrase in drug-interaction or pharmacology text, just before the phrase's head or its next word. Examples are '-induced' before 'platelet aggregation', 'C max', and 'antidiabetic agents'.
